statement: At version 0.1.0-alpha.0, packed @nessalabs/spec-ledger installs outside this monorepo and exposes bin spec-ledger that runs --help, init, and verify; packed @nessalabs/spec-ledger-client and @nessalabs/spec-ledger-server contain no workspace: or file: dependency protocols and install/resolve against that ledger version.
rationale: Consumers need an installable CLI and read-path packages without cloning the workspace.
